symptom: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout during peak traffic spikes
log_snippet: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections (error 53300)
root_cause: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion caused by unclosed DB connections in order_processor
runbook_fix:
1. Run: kubectl scale deployment order-processor --replicas=2 to drop load
2. Increase max_connections in PgBouncer pooler config from 100 to 400
3. Restart PgBouncer daemon without dropping connections
warning: Do NOT restart the primary PostgreSQL master instance directly, as it will abort active in-flight checkout transactions.

symptom: Redis OOM command not allowed when used memory > maxmemory
log_snippet: OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory' on session_cache
root_cause: JWT session tokens were written without TTL expiration, causing Redis memory to saturate
runbook_fix:
1. Run redis-cli config set maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru
2. Flush volatile session cache keys: redis-cli --scan --pattern 'sess:*' | xargs redis-cli unlink
3. Verify memory usage: redis-cli info memory
warning: Do NOT run FLUSHALL because it will purge persistent user rate-limiting counters.
